title: Joint World Action Models through Differentiable Trajectory Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.17626v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Joint world action models (WAMs) generate future actions and states together, modeling world-action trajectories rather than actions alone. However, trajectory imitation does not ensure that these trajectories are task-effective or consistent with dynamics. We present \textbf{world action trajectory optimization (WATO)}, which optimizes generated actions and future states jointly for control. WATO uses both as references in a dynamics-constrained trajectory optimization problem and differentiates the task loss through the optimized trajectory to train the generator. This makes generated trajectories task-aware and dynamics-consistent while using trajectory optimization only during training. At deployment, WATO directly generates candidate trajectories and ranks them with a world model, without iterative trajectory optimization. Across $7$ visual control environments, WATO improves average success from $79.9\%$ for the imitation joint WAM

translated_title: 基于可微分轨迹优化的联合世界-动作模型
translated_abstract: 联合世界-动作模型（WAM）同时生成未来动作与状态，对“世界-动作”轨迹整体建模，而非仅建模动作本身。然而，轨迹模仿并不能保证这些轨迹具有任务有效性或与动力学一致。我们提出了世界-动作轨迹优化（WATO），它为控制目的对生成的动作和未来状态进行联合优化。WATO 将二者作为参考置于一个动力学约束的轨迹优化问题中，并通过优化后的轨迹对任务损失进行微分来训练生成器。这使得生成的轨迹既具备任务感知能力又与动力学保持一致，同时轨迹优化仅在训练阶段使用。在部署时，WATO 直接生成候选轨迹并用世界模型对其进行排序，无需迭代式轨迹优化。在 7 个视觉控制环境中，WATO 将模仿式联合 WAM 的平均成功率从 79.9%（进一步提升）。
tldr: WATO 通过可微分轨迹优化联合优化生成的动作与未来状态，使世界-动作模型的轨迹既具备任务有效性又符合动力学一致性，且部署时无需迭代轨迹优化。
en_tdlr: WATO leverages differentiable trajectory optimization to jointly train a joint world-action model's generated actions and future states, yielding task-aware and dynamics-consistent trajectories without requiring iterative optimization at deployment.
